_note: Issuer addresses are sourced from prototype/lib/tracked-assets.js. To add an asset: pick the right category, add an entry with code/issuer (classic) or contractId (Soroban), issuerName, and optional fields. yield7d and marketCap default to null — leave null until you've verified with the issuer; the UI renders '—'. venues auto-includes a Stellar Expert link if omitted.

_fieldDocs.issuer: G... address for classic Stellar assets. Set this OR contractId, not both.
_fieldDocs.contractId: C... address for Soroban tokens. Set this OR issuer, not both.
_fieldDocs.issuerName: Display name for the issuing entity.
_fieldDocs.issuerUrl: Official issuer website. Opens in a new tab.
_fieldDocs.description: 1-3 sentence summary shown on the detail page.
_fieldDocs.notes: Short tagline shown in the list view.
_fieldDocs.yield7d: Average 7-day yield as a string (e.g., '5.21%'). null hides the value.
_fieldDocs.marketCap: Market cap as a string (e.g., '$700M'). null hides the value.
_fieldDocs.venues: Array of {name, url} for trading/liquidity venues. Stellar Expert is auto-added.
